style: Professional editorial food photograph for a restaurant menu. Three-quarter view from about 45 degrees. The dish sits centered on a light warm-grey stone tabletop with a subtle texture, soft natural daylight from the upper left, gentle soft shadows, shallow depth of field. Off-white or charcoal matte handmade ceramic tableware. Minimal props at the edge of the frame only: a folded natural linen napkin and dark wooden chopsticks. True-to-life appetizing colors, crisp detail, the whole dish visible with some breathing room. Square 1:1. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no hands, no people.

photos.rainbow-summer-rolls: Three fresh Vietnamese rice-paper summer rolls cut on the diagonal, the translucent rice paper showing only vegetables inside: mango, cucumber, carrot, red cabbage, lettuce, white rice vermicelli, mint and Thai basil. A small ceramic dish of clear amber ginger-lime dipping sauce with red chili flakes. Vegetarian: no shrimp, no meat, no fish, no peanuts, no peanut sauce, no sesame seeds.
photos.chicken-satay-skewers: Four grilled chicken satay skewers on bamboo sticks, golden turmeric-yellow chicken with charcoal grill marks, a small ceramic bowl of thick peanut sauce topped with a few crushed peanuts, a small dish of cucumber relish with thin sliced shallot and red chili, a lime wedge.
photos.mushroom-gyoza: Six pan-fried Japanese gyoza dumplings with crispy golden-brown bottoms arranged in a neat row on a plate, garnished with finely sliced garlic chives, a small dish of dark soy-vinegar dipping sauce. No sesame seeds, no meat.
photos.chili-garlic-prawns: Glossy peeled tiger prawns with tails on, wok-tossed with chopped golden garlic, sliced fresh red chili, spring onion and cilantro, in a shallow charcoal-glazed ceramic dish, lime wedges on the side.
photos.crispy-tofu-bao: Two fluffy white steamed bao buns, folded open like tacos, each filled with crispy golden fried tofu slices brushed with glossy dark hoisin glaze, a drizzle of orange sriracha mayo, thin pickled cucumber slices and cilantro leaves. No peanuts, no nuts, no meat.
photos.pad-thai-with-shrimp: A plate of Pad Thai: stir-fried flat rice noodles with pink cooked shrimp, pieces of scrambled egg, small cubes of golden tofu, fresh bean sprouts and garlic chives, crushed peanuts sprinkled on top, a lime wedge and a pinch of chili flakes.
photos.spicy-miso-ramen: A deep bowl of spicy miso ramen: creamy orange-tinted miso pork broth with droplets of red chili oil, wavy yellow wheat noodles, two slices of chashu pork belly, a halved soft-boiled marinated egg with a jammy yolk, sweetcorn, bean sprouts, sliced spring onion and a few toasted sesame seeds. No nori.
photos.miso-glazed-salmon: A roasted salmon fillet with a glossy caramelized golden miso glaze, sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds and sliced spring onion, two halves of baby bok choy and a small neat mound of white jasmine rice on the plate.
photos.cashew-chicken: Wok-tossed chicken pieces with whole roasted cashew nuts, red bell pepper, onion, spring onion and a few whole dried red chilies in a glossy brown oyster sauce, in a shallow bowl, with a small bowl of white jasmine rice beside it.
photos.korean-bbq-beef-bowl: A rice bowl: thin slices of grilled caramelized marinated beef over white rice, a sunny-side-up fried egg, pickled cucumber slices, julienned pickled carrot, sliced spring onion and toasted sesame seeds. No kimchi.
photos.green-vegetable-curry: A bowl of Thai green curry: pale green coconut curry with Thai eggplant, chunks of orange pumpkin, green beans, bamboo shoots, Thai basil leaves and a few red chili slices, with a small bowl of white jasmine rice beside it. Vegetables only: no meat, no shrimp, no tofu.
photos.mango-sticky-rice: Thai mango sticky rice: fanned slices of ripe yellow mango beside a neat mound of white glutinous sticky rice drizzled with coconut cream, one small mint leaf. No sesame seeds, no seeds, no beans, nothing sprinkled on top.
photos.matcha-tiramisu: A neat square portion of matcha tiramisu on a small plate, showing clean layers of soaked ladyfingers and white mascarpone cream, the top dusted with bright green matcha powder, a small dessert fork beside it. No nuts, no chocolate.
photos.black-sesame-ice-cream: Two round scoops of grey-black black sesame ice cream in a small ceramic bowl, with shards of golden almond brittle studded with sliced almonds. No peanuts, no chocolate.
photos.lemongrass-ginger-lemonade: A tall glass of sparkling lemonade with ice cubes, a lemon wheel, a lemongrass stalk as a stirrer and a few thin slices of fresh ginger, light condensation on the glass, a small dish with lemon halves beside it.
photos.lychee-mint-spritz: A stemless glass of pale sparkling non-alcoholic lychee spritz with ice, peeled white lychees in the glass, a fresh mint sprig and a lime wheel, light condensation, a few fresh lychees in their pink shells beside the glass.
photos.thai-iced-tea: A tall glass of Thai iced tea: vivid orange tea over ice with a layer of creamy white milk swirling down from the top, light condensation, a star anise beside the glass.
photos.vietnamese-iced-coffee: A short glass of Vietnamese iced coffee: dark coffee over ice cubes with a pale layer of sweetened condensed milk at the bottom, a small metal phin drip filter on a saucer beside the glass.
photos.jasmine-green-tea: A small handmade off-white ceramic teapot and a small handleless cup of pale golden jasmine green tea with gentle steam, a few dried jasmine flowers scattered on the stone.
